title: mirabilis laevis var. glutinosa
intro: Mirabilis laevis var. glutinosa, commonly known as the Sticky Four-O'Clock, is a plant species belonging to the Nyctaginaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various skin conditions such as eczema, acne, and wounds, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mirabilis laevis var. glutinosa include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
